name: Human Brain (Cerebrum, Cerebellum & Brainstem)
semanticDescription: Medical-grade anatomically accurate 3D model of the human Central Nervous System (Brain). Features complete bilateral cerebral hemispheres with authentic cortical gyri and sulci (Frontal, Parietal, Temporal with temporal pole and insula, Occipital lobes), Cerebellum with horizontal folial striping, Brainstem (Midbrain with superior/inferior colliculi, Pons, Medulla Oblongata with pyramids and olives, and Cervical Spinal Cord), and internal medial diencephalon structures exposed via sagittal section (C-shaped arch of Corpus Callosum, Thalamus, Hypothalamus, Pituitary Gland/Hypophysis, Optic Chiasm, Pineal Gland, and CSF Ventricles).
simplifications: Modular collection hierarchy enables dual visualization: full bilateral brain or medial sagittal cross-section (NCERT Class 10 Fig 6.3)
Cortical gyri and sulci preserved with physiological subsurface scattering and vascular cavity ambient occlusion
Ventricular system rendered with translucent cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) refractive shader

materials.look: Gray matter cerebral cortex with subsurface scattering and sulcal cavity depth
Foliated cerebellar cortex (terra-cotta) with horizontal folial striations
Brainstem nerve tracts and spinal cord with subsurface scattering
White matter commissural tract arch with high-translucency subsurface scattering
Myelinated optic chiasm and visual pathway tract
